scope: R142 Oracle monitor screen; no router acceptance
schedule: All six permutations of labels, in itertools.permutations order; serial subjects and modes, with a fresh daemon per case.
decision: Candidate/R136 monitor mean ratio median strictly below 0.97 and at least five of six blocks below one. Reject if any of three modes times mean/p95/p99 has ratio median strictly above 1.03 and at least five of six blocks above one.
numeric: Recompute latency, wall and process-clock metrics from raw integers. Use exact Fraction ratios and medians for all strict thresholds.
interpretation: Report candidate versus both C and R136 on every metric. Inclusive plus/minus 1% is unresolved, not equivalence. CPU and C comparisons are descriptive, with no extra hard gate.
stopping: One frozen monitor-only generic candidate, exactly 54 cases; no selected blocks, retries or extra samples to rescue the screen.
limits: Original 1705 helper: small payload, one monitor, caller poll/validation included in latency. Separate large-message memory guard and exact candidate correctness remain required; no claim of fixing unmonitored registration tails.
